name: API-Based Evidence Collection
description: Ability to collect forensic evidence from cloud and SaaS platforms using APIs. Covers using provider APIs to export mailboxes, drive contents, user activity, admin audit logs, and platform-specific evidence. Includes understanding API rate limits, pagination, authentication, and ensuring collected data meets forensic integrity standards.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to API-based forensic evidence collection

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands that cloud and SaaS platforms provide APIs for evidence collection and the advantages over manual methods
evidence: Can explain why API-based collection is often the only option for cloud evidence
Understands basic REST API concepts (authentication, endpoints, pagination)
Can describe the types of evidence available via major platform APIs (Google Workspace, M365)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Uses existing scripts and tools to collect evidence via APIs under supervision
evidence: Collected Microsoft 365 mailbox content using compliance eDiscovery tools under guidance
Used Google Workspace Admin SDK to export user data with supervisor oversight
Applied API-based collection tools to gather Slack or similar SaaS platform data
Documented API collection parameters, timestamps, and output verification

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently plans and executes API-based evidence collection across major cloud and SaaS platforms
evidence: Independently collected evidence via APIs in 5+ investigations
Handled API authentication, rate limiting, and pagination to ensure complete collection
Verified collected data integrity through hashing and record count validation
Produced API collection reports documenting scope, method, and completeness

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom API collection tools; handles complex multi-platform collection; addresses API limitations and gaps
evidence: Developed custom API collection scripts for platforms lacking forensic tool support
Designed collection workflows handling cross-platform data correlation requirements
Identified and worked around API limitations that could result in incomplete collection
Mentors junior analysts on API-based collection methodology and tool development

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines API evidence collection methodology; evaluates platform API forensic capabilities; advises on SaaS forensic readiness
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's API-based evidence collection methodology
Evaluated and documented forensic capabilities and limitations of major platform APIs
Advised organisations on SaaS platform selection considering forensic evidence availability
Trains teams on API-based forensic collection techniques and tool development

assessment_methods.description: Collect evidence from a test Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace tenant using APIs, handle pagination and rate limits, and verify collection completeness
Review API collection logs and documentation from recent cloud forensic engagements for completeness and integrity verification
